thread:
maya (support): Customer ACME (ticket #9872) has escalated — auditor says audit logs for KMS/HSM key rotation are missing from the evidence pack. They want ISO27001 mapping + raw log proof. Repro steps they provided below. Can eng + compliance triage? :urgent:

maya (support): Repro steps provided by customer:
```
1) Request to /v1/keys/rotate with header X-Request-Id: req_2026_03_16_01
2) Response 200
3) Auditor can't find corresponding audit entry in central audit index for that request_id
```

raj (eng-runtime): On it. Which environment? prod/dedicated/private?

maya (support): prod (us-west-2). They attached request_id above and a sample HSM export file name: hsm-export-2026-03-16T16-10.json.gz

tim (infra): I can pull the raw audit logs. Running quick search: `aws logs filter-log-events --log-group-name /redwood/audit --filter-pattern 'req_2026_03_16_01' --start-time 1710000000000` — will paste results in a sec.

raj (eng-runtime): Also check KMS alias `alias/redwood/prod` and our KMS rotation webhook consumer. Might be a shipper enrichment bug that strips tenant_id.

sophia (compliance): Heads-up: auditor asked for ISO mapping + retention excerpt. I'll need redacted evidence (no raw PII). I can assemble control-mapping to ISO27001 Annex A (A.8, A.12.4, A.9.2). Please flag any records that contain customer identifiers.

compliance-bot: CHECKLIST: [ ] HSM export attached [ ] S3 checksum provided [ ] Ingestion logs exported [ ] Redaction applied [ ] ISO control map attached. See https://confluence.redwood.internal/compliance/evidence-guidelines

elaine (customer): Thanks. Auditor wants this by EOD tomorrow. Can you confirm you'll provide a redacted pack + mapping?

raj (eng-runtime): Pulled events locally — I see the HSM export contains rotation event at 2026-03-16T16:10:12Z with key_id = key-prod-42, but the central index shows no matching event. Quick grep output: `zcat hsm-export-2026-03-16T16-10.json.gz | jq '.events[] | select(.request_id=="req_2026_03_16_01")'` -> returns the rotation event.

raj (eng-runtime): However, ingestion logs show a gap: our shipper hit a transient Kafka rebalance at ~16:12 UTC and dropped 3 offsets before retrying. Suspect the enrichment step removed tenant_id for these messages, causing downstream filter to drop them.

tim (infra): Confirmed. Offsets in topic compliance-audit: start_offset=2345012, last_success=2345015, dropped_offsets=[2345013,2345014,2345015]. Opening infra incident IR-2026-53 and attaching offset dump + broker logs.

maya (support): Can you capture the exact raw lines we will include in the evidence pack (redacted) and the S3 path for the HSM export? We'll need checksums.

tim (infra): S3 path: s3://redwood-compliance/hsm-exports/2026/03/hsm-export-2026-03-16T16-10.json.gz, checksum sha256: `f7c3bc1d...` (will generate full). I'll also attach broker logs snippet showing rebalance.

sophia (compliance): For ISO pack, include: (1) HSM export (redacted) + sha256, (2) ingestion logs with rebalance evidence, (3) mapping doc that ties event -> control (A.12.4 logging, A.9.2 access control), (4) timeline showing rotation + ingestion gap, (5) corrective action plan. I'll draft mapping and a short statement about retention policy.

raj (eng-runtime): Quick repro command to fetch ingestion lines: `kafka-console-consumer --bootstrap-server b-1.kafka.prod:9092 --topic compliance-audit --offset 2345010 --partition 3 --max-messages 30` — sample output attached. Shows raw event without tenant_id for the dropped batch.

elaine (customer): Please ensure no PII (names, emails, full account ids) in what you share. Auditors still want sufficient detail to verify chain-of-custody.

maya (support): Noted. We will redact at field level and provide a redaction manifest. ETA for preliminary evidence pack: 2026-03-18 18:00 UTC. Final pack after infra incident closure.

compliance-bot: ACTION CREATED: evidence-pack-9872 by sophia (compliance). Due: 2026-03-18T18:00:00Z. Please update when attachments are uploaded.

raj (eng-runtime): I'll produce a redacted event extract (replace tenant_id with [REDACTED_TENANT]) and include the jq filter used so auditor can see transformation. Example filter: `jq 'del(.user.email) | .tenant_id="[REDACTED_TENANT]"'`.

tim (infra): Infra incident IR-2026-53 created and linked to ticket #9872. Attaching broker logs + offsets.

maya (support): Assigning owners: raj + tim for repro + infra evidence, sophia for ISO mapping & redaction. I'll update customer now and keep thread posted. :thumbsup:

elaine (customer): Thanks, team. Please confirm when draft pack is uploaded to secure share.

maya (support): Will confirm upload (secure link) once available.
